run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and NSW (buy.nsw/NSW eTendering) covered via search-indexed detail; partial reads of Victoria, Queensland, WA, SA, Tasmania, NT and ACT portals. Tier 2 sampled (CSIRO, universities incl. Monash/UQ/Griffith, water GBEs, VendorPanel councils). Tier 3 attempted (SAP Ariba Discovery, EstimateOne, major-buyer portals) but no publicly-visible corporate RFx was readable. MAJOR LIMITATION THIS RUN: direct WebFetch to essentially every Australian government, council, water-corporation and e-sourcing portal returned HTTP 403 from the destination site's bot/WAF protection (the egress proxy itself reported healthy with no relay failures). Tender detail was therefore reconstructed from search-engine indexed snippets rather than the notices themselves, so some fields could not be verified to primary-source fidelity and are left null. Prioritised opportunities open or closing in the next ~2 weeks. No tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: WebFetch blocked (HTTP 403 from destination WAF, not the proxy) on: tenders.gov.au (ATM index + all /Atm/Show detail pages), tenders.nsw.gov.au RSS, tenders.vic.gov.au / buyingfor.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au, health.qld.gov.au current-tenders, tenders.wa.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au (incl. /Tender/Details/4816), vendorpanel.com.au/publictenders, service.ariba.com Discovery, and individual council sites (Cabonne, East Gippsland, Wentworth). All tender detail below was therefore taken from search-indexed summaries, not primary notice pages.

SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: could not read the public posting board (login/JS-gated + 403 on direct fetch). No Australian corporate RFx captured as a tender this run; portal recorded in discovered_sources only, per invitation/registration-gated policy.
EstimateOne, iTWOcx, BidContender (construction subcontractor packages): live package listings require a supplier login; not readable this run. No subcontractor packages captured.

Tier 3 major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ, Telstra/Optus, AGL/Origin): supplier opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated; no publicly-visible open RFx surfaced this run. Recorded as sources on prior runs; not re-fetched today due to 403s.

NT QTOL: a Department of Logistics and Infrastructure tender closing 31-Aug-2026 14:00 ACST is indexed (tendersonline.nt.gov.au/Tender/Details/4816) but the title/reference could not be extracted (403 on detail page); not recorded as a tender to avoid fabrication.

Old Nowra Bridge steel-recycling RFT: search results disagreed on the closing date (11-Aug-2026 vs 13-Aug-2026). Recorded as 2026-08-11 with the discrepancy flagged in notes; verify against buy.nsw before relying on it.

Victoria, Queensland, WA, SA, Tasmania, ACT core portals: only landing/index pages were reachable via search; no new jurisdiction-specific tender detail could be confirmed this run. Deferred to a future run when portal fetch succeeds.

CSIRO EOI (Parkes Observatory food & beverage) and Monash University RFT (Student Conduct case-management): captured at headline level only; closing dates, documents and full scope not extractable (AusTender/TenderLink detail pages 403). Left null; flagged in entries_pending_detail.

tenders.title: Old Nowra Bridge – Zinc Chromate Painted Steel Recycling
tenders.category: Environmental / waste and metal recycling services
tenders.description: Transport for NSW's Transport Infrastructure Projects is seeking a contractor to remove zinc-chromate painted steel elements from the decommissioned Old Nowra Bridge and recycle the steel, managing the hazardous coating appropriately.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Removal of zinc-chromate painted steel from the Old Nowra Bridge and subsequent recycling of that steel, including safe handling and disposal of the hazardous zinc-chromate coating in accordance with environmental requirements.
key_deliverables: Removal of zinc-chromate painted steel elements from the Old Nowra Bridge
Compliant management of the zinc-chromate (hazardous) coating
tenders.submission_method: Lodge online via NSW eTendering / buy.nsw
tenders.detail_source: buy.nsw / NSW eTendering listing as indexed by web search (primary notice page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via search of NSW eTendering / buy.nsw current RFTs; buyer-originated notice published by Transport for NSW on the NSW state procurement portal.
tenders.notes: Closing date conflicting across search snippets (11-Aug-2026 vs 13-Aug-2026); recorded 2026-08-11, verify on buy.nsw. Deliverables/scope summarised from the listing description; full specification documents not readable this run (403).

tenders.title: Welding Aptitude Testing Program
tenders.description: The Australian Submarine Agency is seeking a suitably qualified supplier to design and deliver a Welding Aptitude Testing Program to help identify and develop future welders for the AUKUS submarine enterprise.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Design and delivery of a Welding Aptitude Testing Program that attracts applicants, facilitates hands-on welding construction and assessment activities, determines candidates' suitability for welding careers, and provides career-oriented conversations and participant follow-up. Program targets testing 400 candidates over four years, aimed at individuals with limited to no prior welding experience.
key_deliverables: Facilitate hands-on welding construction and assessment activities
Assess and determine candidates' suitability for careers in welding
Conduct career-oriented conversations and participant follow-up
Test approximately 400 candidates over four years
tenders.scope_of_work: The ASA seeks to engage a supplier to run a testing program for individuals with limited to no welding experience, testing around 400 candidates over four years to determine aptitude and suitability for welding careers supporting the submarine workforce.
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market (open to all suppliers).
tenders.contract_term: Program spans approximately four years (400 candidates over four years).
tenders.submission_method: Lodge electronically via AusTender using the Lodgement Page link on the ATM notice
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM RFT/WLD/2026 as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Previously tracked ATM; still open and closing 3-Aug-2026. Detail refreshed this run with fuller scope (400 candidates over four years) from search-indexed summary. Buyer-originated on AusTender.
tenders.notes: Known/active opportunity refreshed with additional scope detail; closing very soon (3-Aug-2026). Contacts and documents not readable this run (403).

tenders.title: ANSTO Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project – Industry Briefing / Upcoming RFT
tenders.buyer: Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation (ANSTO)
tenders.description: ANSTO is holding an online industry briefing ahead of an upcoming open Request for Tender for the Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project at its Lucas Heights campus – construction of a new intermediate-level waste storage facility. The formal RFT is anticipated to be released via an open approach to market in early August 2026.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Upcoming works (RFT to follow) to construct a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility within ANSTO's highly regulated operational environment, including significant reinforced concrete structures, specialist fabricated components, mechanical and electrical services, and integration of process systems requiring high standards of quality assurance, traceability, inspection and testing.
key_deliverables: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility (works to be scoped in the forthcoming RFT)
Integration of process systems with QA, traceability, inspection and testing
tenders.scope_of_work: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility at ANSTO's Lucas Heights campus within a highly regulated nuclear operational environment.
tenders.eligibility: Construction contractors interested in the upcoming RFT; industry briefing open to interested organisations who register.
tenders.briefing: Online industry briefing via Microsoft Teams on 31 July 2026 at 2:00 PM; register attendance by emailing jenksm@ansto.gov.au before 4:00 PM AEST on 29 July 2026. Formal open RFT anticipated early August 2026.
tenders.submission_method: Register interest for the industry briefing by email; formal RFT to be released via AusTender open approach to market
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM PSC002897/Brief as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Previously tracked market-sounding notice; still active with the industry briefing scheduled 31-Jul-2026 and the RFT expected early August 2026. Buyer-originated on AusTender.
tenders.notes: Market-sounding / pre-RFT notice (not yet a live tender). Time-critical: briefing 31-Jul-2026. Watch for the open RFT on AusTender in early August 2026.

tenders.title: EOI – Café-style Food and Beverage Services, CSIRO Parkes Observatory
tenders.buyer: CSIRO (Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation)
tenders.description: CSIRO is seeking Expressions of Interest from service providers to operate café-style food and beverage services at the CSIRO Parkes Observatory site (473 Telescope Road, Parkes NSW). The EOI is the first step of a two-step process, with selected respondents to be invited to a subsequent Limited Request for Tender.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Operation of café-style food and beverage services for visitors at the CSIRO Parkes Observatory. This run captured the opportunity at headline level only; full service requirements were not extractable from the notice this run.
key_deliverables: Provision/operation of café-style food and beverage services at the Parkes Observatory visitor site
tenders.eligibility: Two-step process: open EOI, then a Limited RFT to selected respondents.
tenders.delivery_location: CSIRO Parkes Observatory, 473 Telescope Road, Parkes NSW
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM CSIROEOI2026001 as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via search for CSIRO current EOIs; buyer-originated on AusTender. Distinct from the CSIRO grounds-maintenance RFT tracked previously.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only – closing date, documents and full requirements not readable this run (403). Flagged in entries_pending_detail; confirm currency and closing date on AusTender.
